operations.summary: Write the numbers no output may contain (core.blinding.seal) with the scan tolerance and the unsealed quantities; prints only where it wrote them. With real data only the custodian or a person outside the session seals

inputs.name: hist
inputs.constraint: JSON {edges, values}; finite, edges strictly increasing

inputs.name: low
inputs.constraint: lower bound of the blinded region

inputs.name: out
inputs.constraint: the sealed file, outside every audited output

failure_states.meaning: usage or input error (edges, region, tolerance)
protected use refused (status 'refused', core/protected/guard.py): the protected inputs could not be established

operations.summary: Scan output files and directories (positional paths) for sealed values; prints a fixed status (pass, fail, incomplete) and the unreadable files, never a value, token, location or count; details only to --report for the custodian

inputs.name: sealed
inputs.constraint: a sealed file from seal (custodian-held with real data)

inputs.name: report
inputs.constraint: detailed report for the custodian or a person outside the session

inputs.name: exempt
inputs.constraint: repeatable PATH=REASON for outputs checked another way

inputs.name: outputs
inputs.constraint: strict mode: JSON list of every output to publish

failure_states.meaning: a sealed value was found, or a strict-mode failure
no leak found but not every output was read, or protected use refused (status 'refused')
